shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "printf '%s\\n' '--- files ---'; rg --files -g '"'!node_modules'"' | sed -n '1,200p'; printf '%s\\n' '--- next docs candidates ---'; find node_modules/next/dist/docs -maxdepth 3 -type f | sed -n '1,120p'; printf '%s\\n' '--- package ---'; cat package.json"

/bin/bash -lc "printf '%s\\n' '--- view transitions guide ---'; cat node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/view-transitions.md; printf '%s\\n' '--- navigation guide matches ---'; rg -n \"ViewTransition|view transition|transitionTypes|prefetch|loading\" node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/01-getting-started/04-linking-and-navigating.md node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/streaming.md node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference -g '*.md' | sed -n '1,220p'; printf '%s\\n' '--- source files ---'; for f in app/layout.tsx app/page.tsx app/ProductGrid.tsx app/ProductSkeleton.tsx app/product/'[slug]'/page.tsx app/globals.css lib/products.ts next.config.ts; do echo \"### "'$f"; sed -n '"'1,260p' \""'$f"; done'

/bin/bash -lc "printf '%s\\n' '--- guide headings ---'; rg -n '"'^##|''^###|ViewTransition|default|enter|exit|share|Suspense|navigation|reduced'"' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/view-transitions.md; printf '%s\\n' '--- guide middle ---'; sed -n '70,270p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/view-transitions.md; printf '%s\\n' '--- app files ---'; sed -n '1,220p' app/layout.tsx; sed -n '1,220p' app/page.tsx; sed -n '1,240p' app/ProductGrid.tsx; printf '%s\\n' '--- ts config ---'; cat tsconfig.json; printf '%s\\n' '--- React type support ---'; rg -n \"interface ViewTransitionProps|function ViewTransition|type ViewTransition\" node_modules/@types/react node_modules/react -g '*.{d.ts,ts,js}' | sed -n '1,120p'"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '126,310p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/view-transitions.md; printf '%s\\n' '--- React VT types ---'; sed -n '35,85p' node_modules/@types/react/canary.d.ts; printf '%s\\n' '--- Next Link transition type ---'; rg -n \"transitionTypes\" node_modules/next/dist -g '*.{d.ts,ts,tsx,js}' | sed -n '1,100p'; printf '%s\\n' '--- AGENTS ---'; cat AGENTS.md"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '203,285p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/view-transitions.md; printf '%s\\n' '--- Link declaration ---'; rg -n \"transitionTypes\" node_modules/next/dist/client node_modules/next/dist/shared -g '*.d.ts' | sed -n '1,80p'; printf '%s\\n' '--- React types exact ---'; sed -n '43,72p' node_modules/@types/react/canary.d.ts"
/bin/bash -lc "ls -la; test -f next-env.d.ts && cat next-env.d.ts || true; sed -n '1,120p' node_modules/next/types/global.d.ts | rg -n \"canary|experimental\""

/bin/bash -lc "git diff --check; printf '%s\\n' '--- status ---'; git status --short; printf '%s\\n' '--- diff stat ---'; git diff --stat; printf '%s\\n' '--- tsconfig diff ---'; git diff -- tsconfig.json; printf '%s\\n' '--- numbered references ---'; nl -ba next.config.ts; nl -ba app/ProductGrid.tsx; nl -ba app/page.tsx; nl -ba app/product/'[slug]'/page.tsx | sed -n '1,180p'; nl -ba app/globals.css | sed -n '1,300p'"

/bin/bash -lc "apply_patch <<'PATCH'
*** Begin Patch
*** Update File: tsconfig.json
@@
-    \"lib\": [
-      \"dom\",
-      \"dom.iterable\",
-      \"esnext\"
-    ],
+    \"lib\": [\"dom\", \"dom.iterable\", \"esnext\"],
@@
-      \"@/*\": [
-        \"./*\"
-      ]
+      \"@/*\": [\"./*\"]
     }
   },
-  \"include\": [
-    \"next-env.d.ts\",
-    \"**/*.ts\",
-    \"**/*.tsx\",
-    \".next/types/**/*.ts\",
-    \".next/dev/types/**/*.ts\"
-  ],
-  \"exclude\": [
-    \"node_modules\"
-  ]
+  \"include\": [\"next-env.d.ts\", \"**/*.ts\", \"**/*.tsx\", \".next/types/**/*.ts\"],
+  \"exclude\": [\"node_modules\"]
 }
*** End Patch
PATCH
rm -rf .next next-env.d.ts
printf '%s\\n' '--- final checks ---'
git diff --check
git status --short
git diff --stat -- app next.config.ts tsconfig.json"
